title: Tariff Calculation Note: Amount of the One-Hour Express Fee (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
An express order that the free express allowance does not cover is charged the plan's express fee, rounded to the cent, under Delivery & Pickup Services.

## Inputs

- **The order.** The express order concerned is the one most recently placed on the plan, and its express fee is worked out when it is booked, from that order's own record.
- **The plan's express fee.** The express fee per order that the Delivery & Pickup Services tariff gives for the plan held.

## The amount

The express fee booked on the order is the plan's express fee per order, stated to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical express orders)

| Plan held | Express fee per order on the tariff | Express fee booked |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | $12.99 | $12.99 |
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly | $6.99 | $6.99 |
| Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass | $4.99 | $4.99 |
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual | $6.99 | $6.99 |

Where a patient on Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly placed two express orders on the same day, the order worked out is the later-placed of the two, the most recently placed express order on the plan.
